author: Cleo Abram
description:
The moon is drifting away from us! Where is it going? 

It’s drifting about 4 centimeters per year, that's about the rate your fingernails grow, and we know that thanks to MIRRORS astronauts left on the moon. It’s moving away from  us because of the TIDES!  

But will the moon ever actually LEAVE us? 

To find out, watch and subscribe!

#moon #earth #tides #science #space
title: The Moon Is Drifting Away From Us
